wallet_help_modal.title: Your Bitcoin Wallet
wallet_help_modal.hero_description: Send, receive, and manage Bitcoin across multiple networks with complete control of your funds.
wallet_help_modal.multi_network_description: Pay and receive with Bitcoin, Lightning, Liquid, Rootstock, and USDT - all in one wallet.
wallet_help_modal.security_description: You control your keys. Your funds are never held by BitTasker - only you can move your Bitcoin.
wallet_help_modal.lightning_description: Instant Bitcoin payments with Lightning Network. No waiting, no delays, just peer-to-peer speed.
wallet_help_modal.escrow_description: Automatic fund protection with time-locks. Get paid when work is done, refund if it's not.
wallet_help_modal.step1_description: Pay your way using atomic swaps and your preferred network.
wallet_help_modal.step2_description: Your funds are protected by advanced cryptography. Only you and the other party can release payments.
wallet_help_modal.step3_description: Convert your earnings to any supported format - Lightning, Bitcoin, Liquid, or USDT - whenever you want.
wallet_help_modal.benefits_description: Traditional platforms hold your money and take fees. BitTasker puts you in control with Bitcoin's security and Lightning's speed.
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_description: Rootstock Bitcoin (rBTC) is a Bitcoin sidechain that maintains a 1:1 peg with Bitcoin while enabling smart contracts and faster transactions. It's secured by Bitcoin miners through merge-mining, making it one of the most secure Bitcoin sidechains available.
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_security_desc: Secured by Bitcoin miners through merge-mining
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_contracts_desc: Full EVM compatibility for programmable secure payment contracts
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_peg_desc: 1:1 rBTC to BTC ratio maintained through a Proof of Work Peg
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_description: Liquid Bitcoin (L-BTC) is a Bitcoin sidechain designed for fast settlements and enhanced functionality. It provides faster transaction confirmations and additional features while maintaining Bitcoin's security model through federation.
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_settlement_desc: 1-minute block times for quick transaction confirmations
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_scripting_desc: Advanced Bitcoin script capabilities for complex secure payment contracts
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_assets_desc: Native support for multiple digital assets
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_peg_desc: 1:1 L-BTC to BTC ratio through federated peg
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_fees_desc: Predictable transaction costs for all job sizes
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_description: Yes! You can deposit and withdraw using Lightning Bitcoin for instant, low-cost payments. However, for secure payment contracts, we automatically convert Lightning payments to Rootstock to ensure secure, non-custodial fund protection.
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_deposits_desc: Send Lightning payments that are instantly available
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_fees_desc: Pay minimal fees for Lightning transactions
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_conversion_desc: Lightning funds are swapped to rBTC for secure payment contracts
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_withdrawals_desc: Convert secure payment contract funds back to Lightning any time
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_adoption_desc: Lightning is one of the most widely adopted Bitcoin sidechains
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_title: Why doesn't BitTasker just use Lightning for secure payment contracts?
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_description: While Lightning excels at instant payments, creating user-friendly, non-custodial secure payment contracts on Lightning is still technically complex. We use Rootstock for secure payment contracts because it provides the security, privacy, and reliability needed for protecting your funds.
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_channels_desc: Limited number of open channels per node for secure payment contracts
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_time_desc: Secure payment contracts limited to hours, not days or weeks
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_contracts_desc: Lightning lacks programmable secure payment contract functionality
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_multisig_desc: Lightning Network lacks the programmable contract features needed for secure payment contracts
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_risks_desc: Risk of fund loss if Lightning nodes close or go offline

secure_payment_contract_modal.title: Secure Payment Contract
secure_payment_contract_modal.hero_title: How Your Secure Payment Contract Works
secure_payment_contract_modal.hero_description: Your funds are locked in a blockchain smart contract. Only contract rules can release them—no one else can access your money.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_locked: **Funds locked:** Funds stay locked until you accept completed work.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_review: **7-day review period:** You have 7 days to review after completion. If you don't respond, payment releases automatically.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_grace: **1-hour grace period:** Cancel within 1 hour of booking and get a full refund automatically.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_dispute: **Dispute rights:** File disputes within 7 days of completion. If unresolved after 14 days, you get a full refund.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_cancel: **Cancel anytime:** Cancel for a full refund at any point, except within 24 hours of start time.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_no_show: **No-show protection:** If the Taskee doesn't start on time, mark them as no-show. They have 24 hours to respond or you get a full refund.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_guaranteed: **Guaranteed payment:** Once you mark work complete, the Tasker has 7 days to accept. If they don't respond, you're paid automatically after 7 days.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_upfront: **Upfront deposits:** Can request partial payment upfront (claimable after 1-hour grace period).
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_dispute: **Dispute rights:** Can propose how to split payment during disputes (up to 2 proposals).
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_refund: **Voluntary refund:** Can refund the Tasker at any time.
secure_payment_contract_modal.platform_fees_both: **Fees:** Both parties pay fees to BitTasker when money moves. Fees are deducted automatically, not upfront.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_grace: **1 hour grace period:** Cancel for free within 1 hour of creation.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_cancellation: **24-hour cancellation window:** Cancellations within 24 hours of start time may require a fee to the Taskee.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_review: **7-day completion review:** Tasker has 7 days to accept or dispute after you mark complete.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_dispute: **14-day dispute resolution:** If no agreement after 14 days, Tasker gets a full refund.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_no_show: **24-hour no-show response:** Taskees have 24 hours to respond to no-show claims.
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step1: **Step 1:** Tasker files a dispute within 7 days of completion.
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step2: **Step 2:** Either party can propose a payment split (e.g., 60% to Taskee, 40% refund to Tasker).
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step3: **Step 3:** The other party can accept or counter (up to 2 proposals each).
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step4: **Step 4:** If no agreement after 14 days, Tasker gets a full refund.
secure_payment_contract_modal.cancellation_tasker: **Tasker cancellation:** Within 1 hour: Full refund, no fees. After 1 hour: Cancellation fee may apply. Cancellations within 24 hours of start time may require a fee to the Taskee.
secure_payment_contract_modal.cancellation_taskee: **Taskee refund:** Can refund anytime; Tasker gets a full refund with no cancellation fee.
secure_payment_contract_modal.summary: **Summary:** Funds are locked by contract rules. Time limits are automatic. Fees are transparent. Disputes have fair negotiation with automatic refunds if needed.

passkey_overview.title: What Are Passkeys?
passkey_overview.description: Passkeys are a modern, secure way to sign in to BitTasker without using passwords. Instead of remembering a password, you use your device's built-in security (like Face ID, fingerprint, or your device PIN) to unlock your account.
passkey_overview.benefit1: More secure than passwords — uses public-key cryptography that's resistant to phishing and data breaches
passkey_overview.benefit2: Easier to use — just unlock your device the same way you normally do
passkey_overview.benefit3: Private — BitTasker never receives your device password, PIN, or biometric data

passkey_faq.question1: Did you receive a request to unlock your phone, and cancelled the request?
passkey_faq.answer1: Rather than using a new password on BitTasker, you unlock your account with your device security, which unlocks the passkey that's used to access BitTasker. BitTasker never receives your device password, or biometric data. When you see the unlock prompt, please complete it to set up your passkey.
passkey_faq.question2: Do you have a lock screen on your device?
passkey_faq.answer2: You need to use a lock screen on your device to access BitTasker, and keep your account and wallet secure. Passkeys rely on your device's security, so a lock screen (PIN, password, pattern, or biometric) is required. Please set up a lock screen in your device settings if you haven't already.
passkey_faq.question3: Is biometric authentication (Face ID, fingerprint, etc.) set up on your device?
passkey_faq.answer3: While biometrics make passkeys more convenient, they're not required. If biometrics aren't set up, you can use your device PIN or password instead. However, setting up biometrics will make signing in faster and easier. You can set this up in your device's Settings app.
passkey_faq.question4: Have you granted necessary permissions to BitTasker?
passkey_faq.answer4: BitTasker needs permission to use your device's security features to create and use passkeys. On mobile devices, check Settings > Apps > BitTasker > Permissions. On web browsers, ensure you allow the browser to access your device's security features when prompted.
passkey_faq.question5: Is your browser or app up to date?
passkey_faq.answer5: Passkeys require modern browser and app support. Make sure you're using the latest version of your browser (Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox) or the latest version of the BitTasker app. Older versions may not support passkeys properly.
passkey_faq.question6: Did the setup process time out?
passkey_faq.answer6: If the passkey setup timed out, try again. Make sure you complete the unlock prompt quickly when it appears. Also check your internet connection, as a stable connection is needed for the setup process. If it continues to timeout, try closing other apps or restarting your device.
